text: The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend six candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body: Candidate LAB3-148 Candidate LAB3-170 Candidate LAB3-178 Candidate LAB3-145 Candidate LAB3-169 Candidate LAB3-168 Candidate LAB3-132 Candidate LAB3-139 Candidate LAB3-147 Candidate LAB3-114 Candidate LAB3-143 Candidate LAB3-167 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (December 18, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.
